title: Ancient Egyptian Princesses Were Skilled with Weapons, Study Reveals
description: A new study of mummified remains of Middle Kingdom Egyptian royals, including Princesses Ita and Noub Hotep, shows they were buried withdaggers, arrows, and maces and likely knew how to use them. The remains, rediscovered after being forgotten for over a century in the Egyptian Museum, provide evidence of women's active roles in royal and possibly martial life.
